name: Kinetic Serif Mix
inspiration: Measured from a user-supplied 9:16 podcast-clip reference with style-from-reference (see reference-profile.json). No reference media is stored here.
summary: Word-by-word captions that blur in around the speaker, mixing a tight bold sans with an italic serif, plus white full-screen text cards with one red glyph. For talking-head shorts with no B-roll.

palette.notes: White type over darkened footage; text cards are near-white with near-black type (#0b0b0d) and a single red glyph.

motion: Fluid in, snappy out: each word blurs in over 0.26 s on its spoken time; stacks blur out in 0.1 s; hard cuts and hard zoom jumps between shots.
transitions: Hard cuts only. A two-frame red flash before a text card. No wipes or crossfades.
